title: Agent created a patient profile without consent and fabricated DOB
quote:
Would you like to create a demo patient profile?
... Your patient profile is set up.
And your date of birth is July fourth thousand for demo purposes.
details: Caller explicitly said they did not want to create a profile yet, but the agent proceeded to create one anyway and confirmed a fabricated date of birth ("July fourth thousand") without ever obtaining real patient input. This ignores the caller's stated preference and confirms an action that contradicts what the caller asked for.

title: Repeated multi-second response gaps throughout call
details: Telemetry shows several response gaps exceeding 3 seconds (3.158, 2.808, 3.188, 2.908, 3.405, 3.116), including one before the agent answered a direct question about weekday hours. These delays could be noticeable and frustrating to a real caller, though not severe enough to break the conversation.
